# SecuritizeArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SecuritizeArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ISecuritizeArk](../../interfaces/arks/i-securitize-ark.md), [ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md), ERC721Holder

**Title:**
SecuritizeArk

Ark for allocating into a Securitize DS Protocol security token (`DSToken`, e.g. VBILL,
ACRED, STAC). Valuation uses an external NAV oracle.

Asset tracking model:
totalAssets() = (tokenBalance + pendingWithdrawalShares) * oraclePrice
Deposits (synchronous, on-ramp subscription):
- Securitize subscriptions are operator-authorized: an EXCHANGE/ISSUER key signs an EIP-712
`ExecutePreApprovedTransaction` (an internal `subscribe(...)`). The Ark cannot sign — Securitize
provides the signed payload off-chain and the keeper passes it as `board` data
(`requiresKeeperData = true`).
- `_validateBoardData` (the keeper board-data hook, run before `_board`) resolves the fund
on-ramp (DS service id 16384) and checks the payload relays a `subscribe` to that on-ramp which
mints to THIS Ark. `_board` then binds the payload to the boarded amount, approves the base
asset, and relays `executePreApprovedTransaction`. The on-ramp forwards the asset (minus fee) to
the fund custodian and MINTS the DSToken to this Ark in the same transaction. A post-mint check
enforces the minted shares are within `depositSlippage` plus `subscriptionFeeTolerance` of the
oracle-implied amount (catching NAV-source divergence and the on-ramp fee). The relayed
`subscribe` also onboards this Ark in the registry, so no separate onboarding step is needed.
Withdrawals (asynchronous — there is no on-chain off-ramp):
1. `requestWithdrawal`: compliance pre-check, then transfer the DSToken to `custodianWallet` for
off-chain redemption; increase `pendingWithdrawalShares`.
2. `sweep`: the base asset returns from Securitize; the keeper sweeps it to the buffer ark after
the `sweepSlippage` check (governor `emergencySweep` bypasses it). `setArkFrozen` quarantines.
NAV / oracle sources — the single-source fund NAV is available on-chain two ways:
1. Securitize's `ISecuritizeNavProvider`, resolvable via `onRamp().navProvider().rate()`. This is
the operator-set value the on-ramp prices with, but it carries no freshness timestamp and its
service id is marked deprecated in newer DS Protocol sources.
2. The RedStone `*_FUNDAMENTAL` push feed (`AggregatorV3Interface`): same value, with `updatedAt`.
This Ark prices with (2) to enforce `ORACLE_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT`, and cross-checks (1) via the
post-mint `depositSlippage` bound on every subscription.


## State Variables
### DEFAULT_SWAP_SLIPPAGE
Default slippage (0.02%) passed to the swap-helper base.


```solidity
uint256 public constant DEFAULT_SWAP_SLIPPAGE = 2
```


### MAX_SWEEP_SLIPPAGE
Maximum sweep slippage (0.5%)


```solidity
Percentage public constant MAX_SWEEP_SLIPPAGE = Percentage.wrap(PERCENTAGE_FACTOR / 2)
```


### MAX_DEPOSIT_SLIPPAGE
Maximum deposit slippage (0.5%)


```solidity
Percentage public constant MAX_DEPOSIT_SLIPPAGE = Percentage.wrap(PERCENTAGE_FACTOR / 2)
```


### MAX_SUBSCRIPTION_FEE
Maximum configurable on-ramp subscription-fee tolerance (5%).


```solidity
Percentage public constant MAX_SUBSCRIPTION_FEE = Percentage.wrap(PERCENTAGE_FACTOR * 5)
```


### ORACLE_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT
Max age of a NAV answer before it is rejected as stale. Set above the funds'
~daily RedStone update cadence to tolerate weekend/holiday gaps without freezing
valuation (a 24h bound trips on routine ~16h-old updates).


```solidity
uint256 public constant ORACLE_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT = 48 hours
```


### REGISTRY_SERVICE_ID
DS Protocol service id for the registry service (per `IDSServiceConsumer`).


```solidity
uint256 public constant REGISTRY_SERVICE_ID = 4
```


### SECURITIZE_SWAP_SERVICE_ID
DS Protocol service id for the Securitize on-ramp (subscription) contract.

Named `DEPRECATED_SECURITIZE_SWAP` in newer DS Protocol sources but live for the
integrated funds; resolved dynamically so a re-registration is picked up automatically.


```solidity
uint256 public constant SECURITIZE_SWAP_SERVICE_ID = 16384
```


### SUBSCRIBE_SELECTOR
Selector of the on-ramp's `subscribe(string,address,string,uint8[],uint256[],
uint256[],uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes32)` — the only call `_board` will relay.


```solidity
bytes4 internal constant SUBSCRIBE_SELECTOR = 0x3ca90bd4
```


### custodianWallet
The Securitize-controlled wallet that receives the DSToken on redemption requests.


```solidity
address public custodianWallet
```


### shareToken
The Securitize DSToken (fund share token) this Ark holds. Transfers are
compliance-gated; see `IDSToken`.


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable shareToken
```


### registryService
The Securitize registry service, resolved from the DSToken. Used to surface
onboarding status (`isArkOnboarded`).


```solidity
IDSRegistryService public immutable registryService
```


### oracle
NAV price feed: price of 1 DSToken denominated in the underlying asset.

RedStone `*_FUNDAMENTAL` push feed. The same NAV is also resolvable on-chain via
`onRamp().navProvider().rate()` (Securitize's operator-set source), but that has no
`updatedAt`/staleness signal, so this feed is primary; the two are cross-checked on
every subscription via the oracle-derived `depositSlippage` bound.


```solidity
AggregatorV3Interface public immutable oracle
```


### oracleDecimals
Decimals reported by the NAV oracle (RedStone AggregatorV3 feed)


```solidity
uint8 public immutable oracleDecimals
```


### assetDecimals
Decimals of the underlying asset configured on this ark (e.g. 6 for USDC)


```solidity
uint8 public immutable assetDecimals
```


### shareDecimals
Decimals of the Securitize DSToken (share token)


```solidity
uint8 public immutable shareDecimals
```


### ONE_SHARE
One whole DSToken share, in `shareDecimals` (10 ** shareDecimals)


```solidity
uint256 public immutable ONE_SHARE
```


### pendingWithdrawalShares
DSToken shares sent to the custodian for off-chain redemption, pending settlement
via `sweep`. Denominated in DSToken units.


```solidity
uint256 public pendingWithdrawalShares
```


### pendingWithdrawalAssets
Asset value requested at `requestWithdrawal` time. The `sweep` floor (post-slippage)
is measured against this fixed value, so live-NAV drift between request and
settlement cannot spuriously block the sweep.


```solidity
uint256 public pendingWithdrawalAssets
```


### isArkFrozen
True while the ark is quarantined by `setArkFrozen`. Gates state-changing entry
points via `onlyNotFrozen` and forces `totalAssets()` to return the
`_frozenTotalAssets` snapshot instead of recomputing from live state.


```solidity
bool public isArkFrozen
```


### sweepSlippage
Tolerance applied during `sweep` to the expected vs. returned asset amount.


```solidity
Percentage public sweepSlippage
```


### depositSlippage
Tolerance applied to the minted-vs-oracle-implied shares on a subscription (NAV
source divergence between the RedStone feed and Securitize's navProvider).


```solidity
Percentage public depositSlippage
```


### subscriptionFeeTolerance
Additional tolerance for the on-ramp's subscription fee, kept separate from the NAV
divergence `depositSlippage`. Governor-set; defaults to 0.


```solidity
Percentage public subscriptionFeeTolerance
```


### _frozenTotalAssets
Total assets of the ark when it was frozen


```solidity
uint256 private _frozenTotalAssets
```


## Functions
### constructor

Wires the ark to its counterparties and slippage bounds.


```solidity
constructor(
    address _custodianWallet,
    address _shareToken,
    address _oracle,
    Percentage _sweepSlippage,
    Percentage _depositSlippage,
    ArkParams memory _params
)
    ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, DEFAULT_SWAP_SLIPPAGE);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_custodianWallet`|`address`|Securitize-controlled wallet that receives the DSToken on redemption.|
|`_shareToken`|`address`|Securitize DSToken (fund share token).|
|`_oracle`|`address`|NAV price feed for "1 DSToken denominated in the underlying asset".|
|`_sweepSlippage`|`Percentage`|Initial sweep slippage cap; must be `<= MAX_SWEEP_SLIPPAGE` (0.5%).|
|`_depositSlippage`|`Percentage`|Initial deposit slippage cap; must be `<= MAX_DEPOSIT_SLIPPAGE` (0.5%).|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|Standard `ArkParams`. `requiresKeeperData` MUST be true (the on-ramp subscription payload is supplied as keeper board data).|

```solidity
modifier onlyNotFrozen() ;

```

### onRamp

Resolves the fund's Securitize on-ramp from the DSToken's service registry.

Resolved dynamically (not cached) so Securitize re-registrations are picked up. Returns
the zero address if no on-ramp is registered.


```solidity
function onRamp() public view returns (ISecuritizeOnRamp);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`ISecuritizeOnRamp`|The registered Securitize on-ramp, or the zero address if none is registered.|


### setCustodianWallet

Updates the Securitize custodian wallet that receives the DSToken on redemption.

Restricted to the governor role: the keeper must not be able to redirect redemption
shares to an arbitrary (registered) wallet.


```solidity
function setCustodianWallet(address _custodianWallet) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_custodianWallet`|`address`|New Securitize-controlled wallet that receives the DSToken on redemption.|


### setArkFrozen

Freezes or unfreezes the ark. While frozen, `_board`, `requestWithdrawal`, and
`sweep` revert via `onlyNotFrozen`, and `totalAssets()` returns the freeze snapshot.

Pass `type(uint256).max` as `frozenTotalAssets` to snapshot live `totalAssets()`.
Restricted to the keeper role.


```solidity
function setArkFrozen(bool _isArkFrozen, uint256 frozenTotalAssets) external onlyKeeper;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_isArkFrozen`|`bool`|True to freeze the ark, false to unfreeze it.|
|`frozenTotalAssets`|`uint256`|Total assets to report while frozen; `type(uint256).max` snapshots live `totalAssets()`.|


### requestWithdrawal

Requests a withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

Compliance pre-checks, transfers the equivalent DSToken shares to `custodianWallet` for
off-chain redemption, and increases `pendingWithdrawalShares`. Single-threaded: reverts
`PendingWithdrawalActive` if a withdrawal cycle is already in flight.


```solidity
function requestWithdrawal(uint256 amount) external override onlyKeeper onlyNotFrozen;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset to request a withdrawal for.|


### claimWithdrawal

Claims a previously requested withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

No-op: Securitize processes redemptions entirely off-chain.


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal() external override onlyKeeper;
```

### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

No-op: swap-based exits are not supported for this Ark.


```solidity
function withdrawUsingSwap(uint256, bytes calldata) external override onlyKeeper nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`||
|`<none>`|`bytes`||


### sweep

Sweeps the returned base asset to the buffer and clears `pendingWithdrawalShares`.

This function is only callable by the keeper


```solidity
function sweep()
    public
    override
    onlyKeeper
    onlyNotFrozen
    nonReentrant
    returns (address[] memory sweptTokens, uint256[] memory sweptAmounts);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sweptTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the tokens swept|
|`sweptAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the tokens swept|


### emergencySweep

Bypass-slippage variant of `sweep`, sending the full asset balance to the buffer ark.

Used when Securitize returns less than `pendingWithdrawalAssets - sweepSlippage`.
Restricted to the governor role.


```solidity
function emergencySweep()
    external
    onlyGovernor
    nonReentrant
    returns (address[] memory sweptTokens, uint256[] memory sweptAmounts);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sweptTokens`|`address[]`|The single-element list of the swept base asset.|
|`sweptAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The single-element list of the swept asset amount.|

### _board

Subscribes to the fund by relaying a Securitize-signed `executePreApprovedTransaction`
(an internal `subscribe`) supplied as keeper board data. Synchronous: DSToken is
minted to this Ark in the same transaction.

`_validateBoardData` (run by the `board` modifier before this) has already verified the
payload relays a `subscribe` to the resolved on-ramp that mints to THIS Ark. Here we
bind that payload to the boarded `amount`, relay it, and check the minted shares.


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) internal override onlyNotFrozen;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Base-asset amount to subscribe.|
|`data`|`bytes`|ABI-encoded `(bytes signature, ISecuritizeOnRamp.ExecutePreApprovedTransaction)`.|


### _decodeSubscribe

Decodes the on-ramp's `subscribe(...)` calldata, returning the two fields the Ark binds:
the investor wallet (must be this Ark, checked in `_validateBoardData`) and the liquidity
amount (must equal the boarded amount, checked in `_board`). Reverts
`InvalidSubscriptionPayload` unless `inner` is a `subscribe` call.


```solidity
function _decodeSubscribe(bytes memory inner)
    internal
    pure
    returns (address investorWallet, uint256 liquidityAmount);
```

### _sweep

Shared sweep tail: clears `pendingWithdrawalShares` and forwards the asset balance to
the FleetCommander's buffer ark (skipping if this ark *is* the buffer).


```solidity
function _sweep(uint256 amountToSweep)
    internal
    returns (address[] memory sweptTokens, uint256[] memory sweptAmounts);
```

### _disembark

Disabled for nonzero amounts: this Ark exits only via the async
`requestWithdrawal`/`sweep` cycle. A synchronous `disembark`/`move` would otherwise pull
returned USDC out while `pendingWithdrawalShares` still counts it (double-counting +
bricked sweep). `disembark(0, ...)` stays a no-op.


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal view override onlyNotFrozen;
```

### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Always 0: synchronous withdrawal is not supported.


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal pure override returns (uint256);
```

### _harvest

No-op: no rewards generated by this Ark.


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```

### _validateBoardData

`boardData` must be the Securitize-signed on-ramp subscription payload. Validated here
(amount-independent); `_board` binds it to the boarded amount and relays it.


```solidity
function _validateBoardData(bytes calldata data) internal override;
```

### _validateSubscriptionData

Reverts unless `data` ABI-decodes to `(bytes signature, ExecutePreApprovedTransaction)`
whose call relays a `subscribe(...)` to the resolved on-ramp that mints to THIS Ark. The
subscription amount is bound to the boarded amount in `_board` (`amount` is not available
to this hook).


```solidity
function _validateSubscriptionData(bytes calldata data) internal view;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`data`|`bytes`|Keeper-supplied `boardData`.|


### _validateDisembarkData

No-op: this ark accepts no disembarkData payload.


```solidity
function _validateDisembarkData(bytes calldata) internal override;
```

```solidity
function _sharesToAssets(uint256 shares) internal view returns (uint256);
```

### _assetsToShares

Converts an underlying asset amount to DSToken shares via the NAV oracle.

```solidity
function _assetsToShares(uint256 assetAmount) internal view returns (uint256);
```

### _fetchOracleAssetPerSharePrice

Fetches the NAV (1 share priced in the asset) as a `Price`, enforcing positivity and
the heartbeat staleness bound.


```solidity
function _fetchOracleAssetPerSharePrice() internal view returns (Price memory);
```
